name: arith_even_perfect_mod_nine
statement: (n : ℕ) (he : Even n) (hp : n.Perfect) (h6 : n ≠ 6) : n % 9 = 1
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (he : Even n) (hp : n.Perfect) (h6 : n ≠ 6), n % 9 = 1
informal: Every even perfect number other than 6 is ≡ 1 (mod 9) — Euclid–Euler gives n = 2^(q-1)(2^q-1) with q an odd prime; 2 has order 6 mod 9 and q-1 is even, check the three residues of q-1 mod 6.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), Even n → n.Perfect → n ≠ 6 → n % 9 = 1
